checks.name: Products edit Back closes editor, then returns to Dashboard; root fallback stays bounded
Dirty editor restores history before confirmation and preserves edits on Stay; discard closes once
Unsaved route navigation is confirmed before URL changes
Public Catalogue detail and full-image Back close top layer first and retain exact link on Home fallback
Mobile drawer navigation replaces its temporary layer instead of adding a duplicate Back step
Purchase, receiving and pre-order editor Back preserves parent route and normal forward navigation
Shared palette supports orange, blue, green, light and dark with accessible action contrast
Invalid colors normalize; public cache scopes never reuse a different tenant link
Public theme RPC preserves authorization and exposes only validated visual fields
Close adapters, light auth override, multilingual prompt and platform boot are integrated
Recovery fragments are consumed before managed history creates an entry

scope: Deterministic history-port, palette contrast, source integration checks; browser and physical PWA evidence reported separately
